_: Every click answers (Warcraft II's replies, Stronghold's lords; fun audit item 2), grounded: a lord answers like a lord, by their favour band; pressed again and again they grow curt, in character, never a joke. The King's own host answers too (barks.host): its captain on being chosen (host.select, by what the host is doing: its order's kind, ease with none) and on an order (host.order), curt past annoyed_after (host_annoyed). Tune here, not in code.

loyal: My sword is yours, as ever.
The realm is in good hands.
sworn: What would the crown have of us?
steady: The crown has need of us?
cooling: The crown asks much and gives little.
What does the crown want of us now?
We hear you. We have not forgotten.
Our patience has an end, my King.
angry: We have nothing to say to the crown.
The crown sends for us, after all this?
Our gates are shut to you.
Say your piece and be gone.
We remember every slight, Your Grace.

annoyed: Your Grace has my answer already.
I am still at the crown's service.
If the crown has a command, I will hear it.
folk_annoyed: By your leave, the ovens are hot.
If it please Your Grace, I must get on.
Forgive me, my King, the day is short.

besiege: The walls hold, for now, Sire.
We have them shut in, Your Grace.
The engines are working, my King.
garrison: The walls are ours to keep, Sire.
The town sleeps easy with us here.
return: The men want their beds, Sire.

host_annoyed: The men are ready, Your Grace. Still.
